name: homeview-tablet
description: Application Tablette HomeView (Planning Familial & YouTube Music - Style Apple Home)

scripts.prepare:www: mkdir -p www && cp index.html manifest.json www/
scripts.android:init: npm run prepare:www && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run prepare:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
